In surah At-Takwarir (Chapter 101, verses 8-10), Allah (SWT) says, "And indeed We have already sent Messengers as Rulers before you [O Muhammad]; among them there is he to whom We have given the Scripture, but he wasoonerring in it. And there is he to whom We gave a law, judgment and prophethood. If these had believed in that which We have revealed to you, they would have followed you, but instead they rejected; but among them [were some] who had accepted your teachings. Those [who followed Muhammad] are known by Allah; and those who followed you are in reality the guided, [while those who did not] are clearly the losers." The lions here refer to the Prophets of Allah, emphasizing their leadership, courage, and the power of the teachings. Thus, the spiritual significance of the name 'Himaar' - derived from the lion - reflects a connection to the courageous Prophets of Allah, representing a guide and protector in life.
